plugins.name: mlflow
plugins.description: Skills for tracing, evaluating, and improving AI agents with MLflow. Supports the full agent improvement loop: instrument → trace → evaluate → iterate → validate.

skills.name: agent-evaluation
skills.description: Use this when you need to EVALUATE OR IMPROVE or OPTIMIZE an existing LLM agent's output quality - including improving tool selection accuracy, answer quality, reducing costs, or fixing issues where the agent gives wrong/incomplete responses. Evaluates agents systematically using MLflow evaluation with datasets, scorers, and tracing. IMPORTANT - Always also load the instrumenting-with-mlflow-tracing skill before starting any work. Covers end-to-end evaluation workflow or individual components (tracing setup, dataset creation, scorer definition, evaluation execution).
headings: Check entry points in package config
skills.description_zh: 用 MLflow 的数据集、评分器和追踪系统评估改进现有 LLM 智能体的工具选择、答案质量、成本及错误响应；覆盖追踪配置、数据集、评分定义和执行，原说明要求同时使用 instrumenting-with-mlflow-tracing。

skills.name: analyzing-mlflow-session
skills.description: Analyzes an MLflow session — a sequence of traces from a multi-turn chat conversation or interaction. Use when the user asks to debug a chat conversation, review session or chat history, find where a multi-turn chat went wrong, or analyze patterns across turns. Triggers on "analyze this session", "what happened in this conversation", "debug session", "review chat history", "where did this chat go wrong", "session traces", "analyze chat", "debug this chat".
headings: Get the first trace in the session
Fetch the full trace (always outputs JSON, no --output flag needed)
List immediate children of the root span with their inputs/outputs
List turns with their valid assessments (scorer errors filtered out)
Example: Wrong Answer on Chat Turn 5
skills.description_zh: 分析 MLflow 会话中的多轮追踪，调试聊天过程、审阅会话历史，定位出错轮次并识别跨轮次模式。

skills.name: analyzing-mlflow-trace
skills.description: Analyzes a single MLflow trace to answer a user query about it. Use when the user provides a trace ID and asks to debug, investigate, find issues, root-cause errors, understand behavior, or analyze quality. Triggers on "analyze this trace", "what went wrong with this trace", "debug trace", "investigate trace", "why did this trace fail", "root cause this trace".
headings: Fetch full trace to a file (traces get always outputs JSON, no --output flag needed)
skills.description_zh: 依据给定 trace ID 分析单条 MLflow 追踪，定位错误、失败根因、行为问题和输出质量。

skills.name: build-a-scorer
skills.description: Help the user go from zero to a shipped MLflow evaluation prototype by understanding their app, generalizing a small set of atomic quality criteria, and implementing each criterion with the cheapest reliable scorer. Use when the user wants help choosing, creating, or iterating MLflow judges/scorers for an agent, RAG app, LLM app, or GenAI workflow.
headings: Source of truth: introspect, don't memorize
Phase 1: Elicit the user's notion of right and wrong
Phase 3: Generalize into atomic criteria — across both layers
Phase 4: Route each criterion to the cheapest reliable implementation
Phase 5: Sharpen each criterion with the domain expert
Phase 8: Name the validation plan, then hand off
skills.description_zh: 理解智能体、RAG、LLM 应用或生成式 AI 流程，从少量原子质量标准建立 MLflow 评估原型，并为每项标准选择成本最低且可靠的评分器，支持评判器选择、创建与迭代。

skills.name: fix-agent-issue
skills.description: Drives a disciplined explore → plan → implement → verify loop for changing an AI agent''s behavior with confidence — whether fixing a reported failure or introducing a new requirement, business rule, or policy. Grounds the diagnosis in MLflow traces, codifies the desired behavior as a regression test suite (`mlflow.genai.evaluate` assertions in `@mlflow.test` pytest tests), and iterates the agent — not the test — until green, resisting quick system-prompt patches when the real fix is upstream (missing tool, retrieval source, or capability). Use whenever the user wants to fix or change how an agent behaves — e.g. "fix this issue in my agent", "this answer is wrong", "the agent is hallucinating", "improve my agent based on this trace", "make the agent do X instead of Y", "I want the agent to lead with/prioritize/recommend X", "new business rule: the agent should X", "always/never do X", "change the agent''s default behavior" — or when you are debugging an agent''s behavior mid-loop and reaching for source code and output files — "debug this agent", "figure out why the agent did X", "the agent''s output is wrong", "why did the agent produce this" — where the trace is the evidence to read first — or shares a trace they want addressed.
headings: Phase 1: EXPLORE — understand what the trace shows
Read the trace, the full trace
Capture the user's verbal feedback on the trace
Resist the urge to start coding
Phase 2: PLAN — write the test first
Confirm the SCOPE of the change BEFORE writing tests
Codify the user's expectation as a test
Judge model comes from MLFLOW_GENAI_JUDGE_DEFAULT_MODEL — no model= needed below.
There is no built-in "excludes" scorer — write a small custom @scorer for must-NOT-contain checks.
Anti-patterns to call out and reject
Phase 3: IMPLEMENT — smallest change at the diagnosed layer
Phase 4: VERIFY — confirm the fix and check for regressions
skills.description_zh: 以 MLflow 追踪为证据，按探索、计划、实现和验证循环修复或改变智能体行为；用 @mlflow.test 的 pytest 与 mlflow.genai.evaluate 建立回归标准，迭代智能体直到通过，并检查工具、检索来源或能力缺口而非只改提示词。

skills.name: instrumenting-with-mlflow-tracing
skills.description: Instruments Python and TypeScript code with MLflow Tracing for observability. Must be loaded when setting up tracing as part of any workflow including agent evaluation. Triggers on adding tracing, instrumenting agents/LLM apps, getting started with MLflow tracing, tracing specific frameworks (LangGraph, LangChain, OpenAI, Gemini, DSPy, CrewAI, AutoGen), or when another skill references tracing setup. Examples - "How do I add tracing?", "Instrument my agent", "Trace my LangChain app", "Set up tracing for evaluation
headings: Next: debug from the traces you just captured
skills.description_zh: 为 Python 或 TypeScript 的智能体及 LLM 应用接入 MLflow Tracing，提供可观测性和评估所需追踪；覆盖 LangGraph、LangChain、OpenAI、Gemini、DSPy、CrewAI、AutoGen 等框架。

skills.name: mlflow-agent
skills.description: Master dispatcher for all MLflow workflows. Use this skill when the user wants to do anything with MLflow — tracing, evaluating, debugging, or improving an agent. Routes to the right MLflow sub-skill automatically. Triggers on: "use mlflow", "help with mlflow", "mlflow agent", "add mlflow to my project", "trace my agent", "evaluate my agent", or any MLflow task without a specific skill in mind.
skills.description_zh: 作为 MLflow 工作流总入口，将追踪、评估、调试、改进智能体或项目接入请求路由到相应 MLflow 子技能。

skills.name: mlflow-onboarding
skills.description: Onboards users to MLflow by determining their use case (GenAI agents/apps or traditional ML/deep learning) and guiding them through relevant quickstart tutorials and initial integration. If an experiment ID is available, it should be supplied as input to help determine the use case. Use when the user asks to get started with MLflow, set up tracking, add observability, or integrate MLflow into their project. Triggers on "get started with MLflow", "set up MLflow", "onboard to MLflow", "add MLflow to my project", "how do I use MLflow".
headings: Signal 2: Check the Experiment Type Tag
Step 3: Integrate MLflow into the User's Project
skills.description_zh: 判断用户是在开发生成式 AI 智能体应用还是传统机器学习及深度学习，并引导相应 MLflow 快速入门和初始集成；可用实验 ID 辅助识别用途。

skills.name: querying-mlflow-metrics
skills.description: Fetches aggregated trace metrics (token usage, latency, trace counts, quality evaluations) from MLflow tracking servers. Triggers on requests to show metrics, analyze token usage, view LLM costs, check usage trends, or query trace statistics.
skills.description_zh: 从 MLflow tracking server 查询汇总追踪指标，包括 token 用量、延迟、追踪数量和质量评估，用于分析 LLM 成本、使用趋势及统计。

skills.name: retrieving-mlflow-traces
skills.description: Retrieves MLflow traces using CLI or Python API. Use when the user asks to get a trace by ID, find traces, filter traces by status/tags/metadata/execution time, query traces, or debug failed traces. Triggers on "get trace", "search traces", "find failed traces", "filter traces by", "traces slower than", "query MLflow traces".
headings: By Session or User (Common for Debugging)
All traces for a specific session (use backticks for special characters in key)
All traces for a specific user
Failed traces in a session (for root cause analysis)
Session traces ordered by time (to see sequence of events)
Timestamps are in milliseconds since epoch
skills.description_zh: 通过 CLI 或 Python API 获取 MLflow 追踪，按 ID、状态、标签、元数据和执行耗时搜索过滤，用于查询或调试失败追踪。

skills.name: sagemaker-mlflow
skills.description: Connect to SageMaker Managed MLflow (mlflow-app or mlflow-tracking-server ARN) as an MLflow backend, then hand off to the other MLflow skills. Triggers on a SageMaker MLflow ARN (arn:aws:sagemaker:...:mlflow-app/... or arn:aws:sagemaker:...:mlflow-tracking-server/...) or "SageMaker Managed MLflow".
skills.description_zh: 使用 SageMaker Managed MLflow 的 mlflow-app 或 mlflow-tracking-server ARN 连接后端，再交由其他 MLflow 技能开展相应工作。

skills.name: searching-mlflow-docs
skills.description: Searches and retrieves MLflow documentation from the official docs site. Use when the user asks about MLflow features, APIs, integrations (LangGraph, LangChain, OpenAI, etc.), tracing, tracking, or requests to look up MLflow documentation. Triggers on "how do I use MLflow with X", "find MLflow docs for Y", "MLflow API for Z".
skills.description_zh: 从 MLflow 官方文档站检索功能、API、集成、追踪和实验跟踪说明，回答用法或查找文档请求。
